title: /api/tracker-overview/deliveries
responsibility: Owns the owner-only /api/tracker-overview/deliveries GET and HEAD endpoint: one project's delivered feature video feed and ranged playback of a stored clip.

inputs.name: GET.request
inputs.description: The GET or HEAD request for the exact path; either ?project=<name>[&cursor] for the feed or ?item=<id>&sha=<digest> for a clip. Credentials are read by the verified session resolver.

inputs.name: GET.platform
inputs.description: Cloudflare platform bindings, including the private EVIDENCE bucket and the overview owner setting.

outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: The owner's project delivery page as JSON, or the WebM clip with range support. Every response carries Cache-Control private, no-store and X-Content-Type-Options nosniff.

errors.name: not-found
errors.description: The owner setting is missing, the path is not exact, or no clip or bucket exists for a media read.

errors.name: session-required
errors.description: No verified session resolves from the request.

errors.name: forbidden
errors.description: A verified actor other than the owner.

errors.name: method-not-allowed
errors.description: A method other than GET or HEAD reaches the policy.

errors.name: invalid-input
errors.description: Unknown, missing or malformed query parameters.

errors.name: unavailable
errors.description: The evidence bucket is not bound for a feed read, or the store failed; no store detail is returned.
